The '''Ammu-Nation Clerk''' is a minor character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
The unnamed clerk appears in all [[Ammu-Nation (3D Universe)|Ammu-Nation]] stores around the [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|State of San Andreas]]. If he is attacked, he will pull out two [[Pistol (3D Universe)|Pistols]] and attack the player.
